name: pf-fix-chat-links
about: fix-chat-links against the built package qol instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). Issue #62: link an item in chat from the inventory and hover the link to see the item (fix_chat_links bot). A bag item's hint bar has [L] Link in chat; clicking it and pressing L link the item, and the chat line has no slot or item level; a right-click on the hovered main hand links it (hwp chatlinks rclick stands in for the button, which lab mode can't press); with the menu shut a HUD panel above the chat lists the links in their quality colours, the cursor pinned on one shows that item's tooltip, and off it the tooltip goes; the panel follows ui_chat_pos. Shot chat-link-tooltip: the item tooltip over the panel.
